_doc: Copy to the project as verification.json and fill it. Paths are relative to `root` (relative to this file). Delete a key to switch that check off. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Regexes are Python, escaped for JSON (\d, \|).
_registries: Files that hold ids, one per row. Rows are counted, not unique ids. md: `row_regex` with ONE group = the full id. csv: id column. Used by counts, references, required_mentions and next_id.py.
_counts: Numbers written in prose must equal the registry row count. `regex` has TWO groups: number and label; `labels` maps each label (case-insensitive) to a registry.
_references: Every id cited in `files` must exist in `registry`. The generated document is excluded automatically.
_index: Every file the index cites (regex group 1) must exist in one of `search` folders, and every file matching `must_list` globs must be cited (a new part nobody added to the index fails).
_document:
Single generated deliverable (build.py). `sections` in order: a part path, or {csv, title, delimiter} for a table. `{date}` in notice is today's date; only the date in the title/notice lines is ignored when checking it is up to date. Optional: `separator` between sections (default "

---

").

document.title: # My deliverable
document.notice: > Generated on {date} by `build.py`. Do not edit here: edit the parts and rebuild.

_source_coverage: Every source file must be cited (file name, or stem with match=stem) in at least one of `cited_in`.
_forbidden: Personal data and secrets. defaults=true adds CPF, phone, e-mail, secret. `allow` regexes whitelist a match (e.g. the company domain).
_required_mentions: Terms that must appear in `files`: an explicit list, and/or every id of `registry` from `since` on (e.g. findings added after the last review must reach the summary).
_loop_counter: execution-loop folder: 'NN Name.md' files numbered from 00 with no gap or repeat.
_unique_columns: CSV columns whose values must not repeat.
_custom_checks: Python file (relative to this config) with functions check_<name>(ctx) -> (ok, evidence); ctx has root (Path), config and registries ({name: [ids]}). A crash counts as FAIL.
